# Vendored libraries

Generated by `npm run vendor` (`scripts/vendor.mjs`); do not edit. Each `.mjs` file bundles one library, only the names the program imports from it, and starts with the packages and versions it holds. Each `.d.mts` file gives the type checker that library's own types. The license texts are in `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`.

| File | Library | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `yaml.mjs` | `yaml` | Front matter and the YAML records inside documents |
| `ajv.mjs` | `ajv` | Checking records against the schemas in `../schema/` |
| `markdown.mjs` | `mdast-util-from-markdown` | Headings and fenced blocks |
| `gherkin.mjs` | `@cucumber/gherkin`, `@cucumber/messages` | A spec's Gherkin block |
